facts.fact: The StackAdapt interview page was published on April 25, 2018.
According to co-founder Vitaly Pecherskiy, StackAdapt started in 2013.
facts.quote: It has taken longer than we anticipated in 2013 when we started StackAdapt

facts.fact: According to the company, its co-founders' friendship developed over 5 months before they began working on the business together.
facts.quote: Over the next 5 months, our friendship grew and it became apparent that there was a clear gap in the market for another ad tech player.

facts.fact: According to the company, its early proof of concepts were picked up by a large automotive brand about 9 months into the company's journey.
facts.quote: We started building early proof of concepts that got picked up by a large automotive brand about 9 months into the journey.
